scope: Pre-CU-compatible community content discovery: SR advertised worlds/species; all collected MTG Lua and relevant archive index names; Sunrunner official world/species lists; EiF racial list and credits; original MTG releases; pinned Stardust, Darklight, Hondo and EiF passenger public sources. Private, unindexed and unreleased projects can contain additional content.

rows.availability: Collected MTG assets; additional published source or original release links
rows.notes: Original mini-expansion was released for server administrators. MTG terrain and snapshot are present. SR later quests are separate.
